decisions.why: Examples are a Schimmelbusch sterilisation drum and needle storage cases for reprocessing - core CSSD/central decontamination instrument-packaging products.
Examples are frontal sinus and nasal septum cutting forceps - ENT surgical instruments for sinus/nasal surgery.
Shea, Wullstein and Bellucci micro scissors are classic named otologic (ear surgery) micro-instruments, an ENT surgical instrument family.
Rosen knife and Schuknecht rotary knife are named otologic (stapedectomy/ear surgery) instruments, ENT surgical instruments.
Division name is anaesthesia needles and its example is a pudendal nerve block needle, a regional anaesthesia device.
Example is a plain hypodermic needle, matching the general-purpose syringes & needles type directly.
Example is a maxillary sinus forceps (Heuwieser), an ENT sinus surgery instrument.
Example is a Luniatschek nasal packing instrument, used for ENT nasal tamponade procedures.
Fisch perforator is a named otologic/temporal bone surgery instrument associated with ear and skull base ENT surgery.
